config.script:
# Dev-only script checks for system.mapstudio (epic 2 story 1, criteria 4, 7 and 8).
	# A Perspective session script runs on the Gateway, so these calls take the same write
	# service as the browser, under the actor they name (the scripting API trusts its caller).
	import java.lang
	import uuid

	project = 'mapstudio-dev'
	actor = 'seed-script'
	logger = system.util.getLogger('MapStudio.devchecks')
	results = []
	out = self.view.rootContainer.getChild('scriptResults')

	# The scripting API trusts its caller (docs/contract.md), so this view checks the role
	# itself: only a signed-in session whose user holds MapEditor may run the writes. The
	# session's auth props are set by the Gateway from its identity provider.
	roles = []
	try:
		if self.session.props.auth.authenticated:
			roles = [str(r) for r in (self.session.props.auth.user.roles or [])]
	except java.lang.Throwable as ex:
		roles = []
	except Exception as ex:
		roles = []
	if 'MapEditor' not in roles:
		out.props.text = system.util.jsonEncode({'refused': 'The script checks write to the map store, so they need the MapEditor role. Sign in as a map editor first.'})
		logger.info('Dev script checks refused: the session user does not hold MapEditor.')
		return

	def call(name, fn):
		try:
			results.append({'name': name, 'ok': True, 'value': fn()})
		except java.lang.Throwable as ex:
			results.append({'name': name, 'ok': False, 'error': ex.getMessage()})
		except Exception as ex:
			results.append({'name': name, 'ok': False, 'error': str(ex)})

	def batch(ops):
		return {'batchId': str(uuid.uuid4()), 'ops': ops}

	def stored_version(item_id):
		for item in system.mapstudio.getMap(project):
			if item['id'] == item_id:
				return item['version']
		return None

	# A new UUIDv5 per run (the run's time in the name), so the checks repeat on a kept volume.
	run = str(system.date.toMillis(system.date.now()))
	point_id = str(uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, 'mapstudio-dev/script-check/' + run))
	point = {'kind': 'pad', 'name': 'Script check pad',
		'geometry': {'type': 'Point', 'coordinates': [-104.9650, 39.7360]}}

	call('create', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([
		{'op': 'create', 'entity': 'item', 'id': point_id, 'baseVersion': 0, 'data': point}]), actor))
	call('getMapAfterCreate', lambda: stored_version(point_id))
	call('updateAtStoredVersion', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([
		{'op': 'update', 'entity': 'item', 'id': point_id, 'baseVersion': 1,
		'data': {'name': 'Script check pad (renamed)'}}]), actor))
	call('updateAtOldVersion', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([
		{'op': 'update', 'entity': 'item', 'id': point_id, 'baseVersion': 1,
		'data': {'name': 'Stale rename'}}]), actor))
	call('staleDelete', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([
		{'op': 'delete', 'entity': 'item', 'id': point_id, 'baseVersion': 1, 'data': {}}]), actor))
	call('noActor', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([
		{'op': 'update', 'entity': 'item', 'id': point_id, 'baseVersion': 2,
		'data': {'name': 'No actor'}}]), None))
	call('unknownProject', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits('no-such-project', batch([
		{'op': 'create', 'entity': 'item', 'id': str(uuid.uuid4()), 'baseVersion': 0, 'data': point}]), actor))
	call('getMapAtEnd', lambda: stored_version(point_id))
	call('ping', lambda: system.mapstudio.ping())

	# Kind setups and item checks (epic 2 story 9): the pad kind setup saved at its stored
	# version, read back through getMap().kindSetups, a bad placeholder refused, and a
	# CSV-style number stored as a number.
	pad_setup = {
		'comms': {'path': '{asset.path}/Comms', 'on': True},
		'kpis': [
			{'key': 'pressure', 'label': 'Pressure', 'path': '{asset.path}/Pressure', 'unit': 'psi', 'on': True, 'icon': True},
			{'key': 'gas', 'label': 'Gas price', 'path': '[default]Shared/GasPrice', 'unit': '', 'on': False, 'icon': False}],
		'alarms': {'path': '{asset.path}', 'count': True, 'summary': True},
		'link': '/pad/{item.name}',
		'popupView': {'path': 'Popups/PadDetails', 'params': {'padName': '{item.name}', 'tagPath': '{asset.path}',
			'area': 'Mesa', 'pressure': '{asset.path}/Pressure'}},
		'styleRule': {'source': {'kpi': 'pressure'}, 'type': 'bands', 'cases': [
			{'min': None, 'max': 900, 'preset': 'normal'}, {'min': 900, 'max': None, 'preset': 'warning'}]}}

	def stored_kind_setup(kind_id):
		for setup in system.mapstudio.getMap(project).kindSetups:
			if setup['kindId'] == kind_id:
				return setup
		return None

	def kind_setup_op(kind_id, setup):
		current = stored_kind_setup(kind_id)
		if current is None:
			return {'op': 'create', 'entity': 'kindSetup', 'id': kind_id, 'baseVersion': 0, 'data': {'setup': setup}}
		return {'op': 'update', 'entity': 'kindSetup', 'id': kind_id, 'baseVersion': current['version'],
			'data': {'setup': setup}}

	call('kindSetupSave', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([kind_setup_op('pad', pad_setup)]), actor))
	call('kindSetupFromGetMap', lambda: stored_kind_setup('pad'))
	call('kindSetupBadPlaceholder', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([
		kind_setup_op('pad', {'link': '/pad/{item.foo}'})]), actor))
	csv_id = str(uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, 'mapstudio-dev/script-check-csv/' + run))
	csv_pad = {'kind': 'pad', 'name': 'Script check CSV pad', 'properties': {'wells': '12'},
		'geometry': {'type': 'Point', 'coordinates': [-104.9660, 39.7365]}}
	call('itemCsvNumber', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([
		{'op': 'create', 'entity': 'item', 'id': csv_id, 'baseVersion': 0, 'data': csv_pad}]), actor))
	call('itemCsvNumberStored', lambda: [i['properties'] for i in system.mapstudio.getMap(project) if i['id'] == csv_id])
	call('itemUnknownKind', lambda: system.mapstudio.applyEdits(project, batch([
		{'op': 'create', 'entity': 'item', 'id': str(uuid.uuid4()), 'baseVersion': 0,
		'data': {'kind': 'tank', 'geometry': csv_pad['geometry']}}]), actor))

	out.props.text = system.util.jsonEncode({'pointId': point_id, 'results': results})
	logger.info('Dev script checks ran: %d calls' % len(results))
